title: EfficientAD: Accurate Visual Anomaly Detection at Millisecond-Level Latencies
mechanism: Small patch description network teacher, student with hard-feature loss, plus a global autoencoder for logical anomalies; 2 ms per image.
adaptation: Benchmark baseline trained per source on clean pool cells at 512 px; PDN receptive field 33 px is near crack scale. Autoencoder branch can flag layout anomalies (missing busbar, splice) the house model never predicts (splice IoU 0.000).
evidence: R: 32 datasets from three AD collections, SOTA detection and localization at 600 img/s.
min_experiment: Benchmark row: train once, report AD metrics and splice / crack / inactive relF1@2. Optional: splice recall of AE branch on CV; kill if < 0.2 at 1% area.
